name: NASA GIBS (Global Imagery Browse Services)
summary: Keyless tile service (WMTS, WMS, TMS) for daily and historical NASA satellite imagery and derived layers.
description: GIBS serves pre-rendered global imagery layers such as MODIS and VIIRS true-colour reflectance, sea surface temperature, aerosol, fires and snow cover, many with daily time steps going back decades. Tiles are addressed by layer, date, tile matrix set and row/column, for several projections (EPSG:4326, 3857, 3413, 3031). GetCapabilities lists every layer with its time extent.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented on the pages fetched.

endpoints.summary: List layers, time extents and tile matrix sets (XML)
WMS GetMap for a bounding box image

license.name: NASA open data; see the data use guidance and acknowledgements page

coverage.temporal: Per layer; many MODIS layers have daily imagery since 2000 and are available within hours of acquisition

agent_notes: Fetch GetCapabilities once, cache it, and read each layer's Identifier, time extent and TileMatrixSet. The /best/ path serves the best available product. Missing dates return an error or blank tile, so check the layer's time range. Use the tile row/column convention of the matrix set (250m, 500m, 2km ...).
caveats: Imagery, not numeric data: for values use the source dataset via CMR.
The GetCapabilities XML is large; the documented access basics were not exhaustively tested beyond one tile and the capabilities document.
The data-use page was not parsed for exact licence wording.

verification.notes: Exact tile example executed without a key and returned image/jpeg; GetCapabilities returned XML.
